group: Validator processing without errors

group: OpenAPI discriminator handling – register new discriminator (no prior registration)

group: OpenAPI discriminator handling – use already registered discriminator

cases.description: A discriminator is already registered for the current schemaPath. The method should retrieve it, skip registration, and invoke `checkDiscriminatorMatch` with the retrieved discriminator.

group: Validator processing with mixed results – error and non‑error validators

cases.expected: Set containing the ValidationMessage produced by the ErrorValidator. No evaluated items or properties are added to the collector because the error validator is not of type PrefixItems/Items/Contains/Properties/AdditionalProperties/PatternProperties. The non‑error validator’s scope is merged into the parent scope.
cases.description: Two validators are present: one (ErrorValidator) returns a non‑empty error set, the other (NoOpValidator) returns an empty set. The method must aggregate the error, skip adding evaluated items/properties for the error validator, and still merge the dynamic scope of the successful validator.

group: OpenAPI discriminator handling – discriminator propertyName missing
